name: Using Policy Plus
purpose: Start the program, restore its saved settings and leave it again.
membershipRule: Entry points that start or close the program as a whole and restore its own settings (startup, exit). Dialog-specific behaviour belongs to the capability of that dialog's business area; loading definitions belongs to managing policy definitions.

name: Managing policy definitions
purpose: Load, download and inspect the policy definition files (ADMX/ADML) and the products and support rules they declare.
membershipRule: Entry points that load policy definitions from a folder, download the Microsoft ADMX package, choose the ADML language, or list and show details of loaded definition files, categories, products, support definitions and policy elements. Searching and filtering the policy list belongs to finding and browsing policies; changing policy values belongs to setting policies.

name: Finding and browsing policies
purpose: Browse policies by category and find them by text, ID, registry location or filter.
membershipRule: Entry points that navigate the category tree and policy list, search policies (by ID, text, registry key/value) and show results, or configure the filter that narrows the list. Does not change policy values or definition files.

name: Setting policies
purpose: Choose a policy's state and option values and apply them to a computer, user or policy file, including SPOL text import and inspection.
membershipRule: Entry points of the policy setting editor (state, options, list editor, section switch, apply) and of importing or showing a policy's settings as SPOL text. Raw registry-value editing of a policy file and REG import/export belong to editing policy files directly.

name: Editing policy files directly
purpose: Edit the raw keys and values of a policy (POL) file and import or export them as REG scripts.
membershipRule: Entry points of the raw POL editor and its key, value and delete dialogs, and the REG import and export dialogs. Choosing a policy's setting through its definition belongs to setting policies.

name: Policy definition
purpose: The catalogue of Group Policy settings a person can browse and configure: each policy's name, explanation, registry location and the form it is edited through, with its translated texts.
membershipRule: One policy definition catalogue item: a policy, category or supported-product entry from ADMX template files, its ADML translated strings and presentation layouts, and the folders, downloads and packages that supply those template files. Not the values a policy is set to, and not comments on a policy.

name: Policy setting
purpose: The state a policy is configured to (enabled, disabled, or a chosen value) as stored in a policy source: the registry, a policy file (POL), a REG file or a user's registry hive, with the Group Policy version stamp kept beside it.
membershipRule: One configured policy value or policy-source container: a registry key, value name, data and value kind under the policy keys of a local or mounted registry, a Registry.pol / POL / REG file holding them, a user's NTUSER.DAT hive, and the gpt.ini that versions the Group Policy object. Not the catalogue describing the policy, and not comments.

name: Policy comment
purpose: A free-text note an administrator attaches to a policy, kept in a comment file beside the policy definitions.
membershipRule: One comment text attached to one policy ID, in a CMTX comment file and the folder holding it. Not the policy definition or its value.

name: Program setting
purpose: A preference of the Policy Plus application itself, remembered between runs in the current user's registry.
membershipRule: One named user preference of the application kept under its own configuration registry key. Not policy values.

name: Windows user account
purpose: A person's Windows account (name, security identifier and profile folder) whose policies or registry hive are chosen for editing.
membershipRule: One local or domain user account: its name, SID, and profile folder under C:\Users used to find its hive or its policy object. Not the policy values themselves.

name: Building and versioning Policy Plus
purpose: Stamp each build of the program with the Git commit it was made from, so the About box shows it.
membershipRule: Developer-run build-time scripts and steps that produce or stamp the program (version stamping, packaging). Anything a person does inside the running program belongs to the capability of that business area; starting and closing it belongs to using Policy Plus.
